The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: One who honours, giver of honour
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Moez corresponds to the Arabic form معز (Arabic root ع ز ز (ʿ-z-z); مُعِزّ (Muʿizz)). Its core sense is one who honours, giver of honour. Moez is Arabic مُعِزّ (Muʿizz) 'one who honours, giver of honour', from the root ع ز ز (ʿ-z-z). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave مؤذ (a different form); the correct form is مُعِزّ. The source gloss 'Guide, Leader' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as moeez and moiz.

persian.name: معز
persian.long_meaning: Moez (معز) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن معز، عزت‌بخش است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

arabic.name: معز
